output.reason: [ev-17b3774eb9ee] says that users of Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 who upgrade from Strimzi 0.38 or older must make sure the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSets` are used before upgrading.
